description: Checks whether a specific wallet is authorized under a B20 token's transfer-sender policy. If it isn't, that wallet can't transfer and can be burnBlocked() (SEIZED) by the issuer. The personal companion to b20-safety — 'can this token freeze MY funds?'
name: b20_freeze_check

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.

data.description: The result payload. Shape is service-specific; every field is documented in the tool description.

title: B20 Freeze Check
